# Unit, District and Council

## Unit Support

##### Chartered Organizational Representative Training

**Online Learning**



[Click
here](https://my.scouting.org/vim2/webscript/output/proxy.aspx?Method=ExecuteScript&ScriptCode=TaleoCourseDeepLinkSSOAgent&Destination=LearnCenter&Origin=Web&Program=COR)
to go to the Online Learning Plans for this position.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/cor-150x150.jpg)

##### Advanced Unit Chaplain and Chaplain Aide Training

Councils may now provide Unit Chaplain and Unit Chaplain Aide training which
includes participation by the Chartered Organization Representative at their
convenience. This easy to download syllabus is intended to reinforce not only
the relationship with the Chartered Partner but connect these Scouts and
Scouters with other units in their districts and council. They may learn best
practices to strengthen their roles as Chaplains and Chaplain Aides, inspire
more Duty to God activities and foster understanding of the many faiths
represented in Scouting America.

The Course Code for this training is D86.

**Online Learning**

[Click
here](https://my.scouting.org/vim2/webscript/output/proxy.aspx?Method=ExecuteScript&ScriptCode=TaleoCourseDeepLinkSSOAgent&Destination=LearnCenter&Origin=Web&Program=Chaplains)
to go to the Online Learning Plans for this position.



**Facilitated Learning Materials** (_for use by Council/District Training
Staff_)

[Download Syllabus](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2018/04/Chaplain-Training-V-4-04042018.pdf)

##### New Member Coordinator

  
The Welcome training video on the [Volunteer Learn
Center](https://training.scouting.org/courses/SCO_535?bc=W3siaWQiOiIvY2F0YWxvZyIsImlzUGFyZW50Um91dGUiOnRydWUsImtpbmQiOiJjcyIsInRleHQiOiIiLCJzZWFyY2hQYXJhbXMiOiIiLCJ1dWlkIjoiL2NhdGFsb2cifV0=)
is sufficient for you to get started in your exciting new role. Additional
detailed training on Sharing the Benefits of Scouting, Coordinating
Recruitment, and the Joining and Welcoming Process is available in the
Scouting America Members LearnCenter, using the same process for access.

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2018/01/NewMemberCoordinatorLogo-1-300x232.png)

## District/Council Support

##### ![](https://sp-
ao.shortpixel.ai/client/to_webp,q_lossless,ret_img,w_62,h_61/https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2019/08/444-300x293.jpg)   District Committee Basic Training

District Committee Training has been taught the same way for many years with a
very dated course. Today we are happy to announce that by leveraging the
Scouting America Learn Center we are providing the district committee a
learning environment that provides them the content they need when the need it
while leveraging professional training for consistency in district training.
This new learning replaces the District Committee Workshop and provide
learning plans aligned with the various district committee positions and
functions.

Position trained status (D61) will be provided for those who complete their
training. Position training includes:

  * District Committee Chair
  * District Committee Vice Chair
  * Membership Chair
  * Fund Development
  * Training Chair
  * Member at Large
  * Activities and Civil Service Chair
  * Nominating Chair
  * Program Chair
  * Camping and Outdoor Chair
  * Advancement Chair

 _**The online training supersedes the District Committee Workshop – please
discontinue use of the District Committee Workshop.**_

The online training is available in the Scouting America Learn Center on
[My.Scouting](https://my.scouting.org/).
